verdict.rationale: Adyen's docs describe webhooks that push asynchronous status changes to your server so you don't have to poll. The docs also cover a Customer Area log of webhook events sent to your server, and Adyen sends webhook messages with payment outcomes to the merchant's webhook server. Management API tools exposed via MCP can list, get and test webhook configurations. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of registering endpoints and choosing event subscriptions, an event-type catalog, signature/HMAC verification and retry semantics, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
